turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Look at this one first.
"There is an ant on the table." Ant starts with the sound "a". That is a vowel sound, so I write an.
Rule: an before a vowel sound, a before other sounds.
Right: I see a bird. Wrong: I see an bird.

Now you. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
